fine_lines.title: flatmate (UK) vs roommate (US)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: flatmate كلمة بريطانية لشخص يشاركك الشقة. roommate كلمة أمريكية بنفس المعنى تقريبًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Flatmate" (UK) and "roommate" (US) both mean a person you share a home with.

examples.sentence: Living with roommates is new to me.

fine_lines.title: takeout (US) vs takeaway (UK)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان تعنيان طعامًا تشتريه من مطعم وتأكله في البيت.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean restaurant food you take home to eat.

examples.sentence: We had a takeaway on Friday.

expressions.phrase: I haven't seen him in years.
expressions.example: I haven't seen my cousin in years.
Hi Tom! It's been so long!
Nice to meet you, Alex. Likewise.

expressions.phrase: Emily has told me so much about you.
expressions.meaning_en: A friendly thing to say when you meet someone.
expressions.example: My brother has told me so much about you.

expressions.phrase: I couldn't have asked for better flatmates.
expressions.meaning_ar: ما كنت لأحظى بشركاء سكن أفضل.
expressions.meaning_en: You are very happy with people.
expressions.example: I couldn't have asked for a better teacher.

expressions.phrase: We'll show you the best places and help you settle in.
expressions.meaning_ar: سنريك أفضل الأماكن ونساعدك على الاستقرار.
expressions.example: Welcome! We'll help you settle in.

expressions.phrase: Change can be scary, but it's a chance to grow.
expressions.meaning_ar: التغيير قد يكون مخيفًا، لكنه فرصة للنمو.
expressions.example: A new school can be scary, but it's a chance to grow.

expressions.phrase: What do you do for fun?
expressions.example: What do you do for fun? I like reading.

expressions.phrase: It's always good to try before saying no.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الجيد دائمًا أن تجرب قبل أن ترفض.
expressions.example: Taste it first. It's always good to try before saying no.
You walk too fast. I can't keep up!

expressions.phrase: It wasn't my cup of tea.
expressions.example: Horror films are not my cup of tea.

grammar.title: used to + verb (past habits)
grammar.explanation_ar: used to + الفعل الأساسي لعادة في الماضي لم تعد موجودة.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "used to + verb" for past habits that are not true now.
examples: I used to take care of him.
We used to play together as kids.
He used to live in London.

grammar.title: Present perfect: haven't seen / has told
grammar.explanation_ar: have/has + التصريف الثالث لربط الماضي بالحاضر: I haven't seen him in years. Emily has told me about you.
grammar.explanation_en: have/has + past participle connects past and now.
examples: I haven't seen him in years.
Emily has told me so much about you.
I've always dreamed of living here.
